Support is the part of your store customers actually remember.

Your product gets them to the checkout. Your support decides whether they come back. I have spent four years on the front line of that moment, on service desks, in technical support and inside online businesses, and I treat every message as someone's money and patience on the line.

My rule is simple: write it down, or it didn't happen. At Stop Over I kept more than 300 customer records every single day. At NeoLife I sold more than 500 supplement packs, so I know what a customer sounds like right before they buy and right before they walk.

Now I bring both sides to e-commerce. Fast, human replies. Clean records. Problems that get solved instead of passed around.
